ABOUT.TITLE: About Us
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: CuidaDos is a platform designed to be a secure and efficient intermediary for hiring care and assistance services for the elderly or anyone requiring help with daily living. We are a digital care platform created with the goal of improving the quality of life for those needing daily support. Our team consists of professionals from the technological and social sectors who share a single vision: to facilitate access to care and support services in a simple, safe, and transparent way. We firmly believe that personal care must be based on trust, professionalism, and a personal approach, which is why we work to connect users with specialized companies in the sector. The project was born in the context of the Final Project for the Higher Level Vocational Training in Web Application Development, during the 2025-2026 academic year. Based on sector analysis and close experience with this field, gaps were identified that could be resolved through a modern, accessible, and scalable technological solution. Our commitment is to create an inclusive, intuitive, and reliable digital environment that contributes to dignifying the care sector and making life easier for those who need it most.

TERMS_PAGE.TITLE: Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy

SUB_1.TITLE: 1.1. Introduction
SUB_1.TEXT: Welcome to {{appName}}. This application acts as a technological intermediary platform that facilitates contact and service management between users demanding care or services ('Clients') and professionals or entities offering them ('Companies').

SUB_2.TITLE: 1.2. Registration and Security
SUB_2.TEXT: To use the service, the user must register providing truthful data. The password is personal and non-transferable. The user is responsible for all actions taken from their account. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that provide false information or misuse the platform.

SUB_3.TITLE: 1.3. How Contracts Work
SUB_3.TEXT: By clicking the 'Hire' button, a digital link is generated between the Client and the Company. {{appName}} is not a party to this final service contract, acting exclusively as a management and communication tool. Responsibility for the quality, schedule, and execution of the service rests exclusively with the providing Company.

SUB_4.TITLE: 1.4. Conduct Rules and Messaging
SUB_4.TEXT: The internal messaging system must be used exclusively for the coordination of contracted services. Sending spam, offensive, discriminatory, or illegal content is prohibited. Failure to comply with this rule will result in immediate expulsion from the platform.

SECTION_2.TITLE: 2. Privacy Policy and Legal Framework
SECTION_2.INTRO_BOX: This Privacy Policy is governed by current regulations in Spain and Europe, specifically: the GDPR (Regulation EU 2016/679), the LOPD-GDD (Organic Law 3/2018), and the LSSI-CE (Law 34/2002).

SUB_1.TITLE: 2.1. Data Controller
SUB_1.TEXT: The data will be processed by the application owner, based in Spain. For any management related to privacy and data protection, you can contact: {{email}}.

SUB_2.TITLE: 2.2. Data We Collect and Necessity
SUB_2.LIST_1: Identification Data (ID, Name, Date of Birth): Strictly necessary to verify legal age and legal capacity to formalize contracts.
SUB_2.LIST_2: Contact and Location Data: Necessary for the physical execution of the service at the client's location.
SUB_2.LIST_3: Activity Data: Security logs and contracts to comply with LSSI and service traceability.

SUB_3.TITLE: 2.3. Purpose and Legitimacy
SUB_3.TEXT: The legal basis for processing is the execution of the contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR) and compliance with legal obligations. Your data will not be used for purposes other than platform management without your explicit consent.

SUB_4.TITLE: 2.4. Data Transfer
SUB_4.TEXT: Your data will not be transferred to third parties unless there is a legal obligation or contractual necessity:
SUB_4.LIST_1: To the service counterparty (Company/Client) exclusively for the provision of the contracted service.
SUB_4.LIST_2: To technology providers (Data Processors) such as Supabase, which guarantee security according to European standards.

SUB_5.TITLE: 2.5. User Rights
SUB_5.TEXT: In accordance with regulations, you may exercise your rights of Access, Rectification, Deletion, Opposition, Limitation, and Portability by sending an email to the indicated address.

SECTION_1.TITLE: 1. What are cookies and what are they used for?

SUB_1.TITLE: 1.1 Definition of a Cookie
SUB_1.TEXT: A cookie is a small text file that is stored in your browser when you visit our website. Its main purpose is to remember information about your visit to make navigation easier.

SUB_2.TITLE: 1.2 Types of cookies we use
SUB_2.TEXT: We use first-party cookies (managed by us) and third-party cookies (managed by service providers such as Google Analytics).

SUB_3.TITLE: 1.3 Purpose of the cookies
SUB_3.TEXT: We use technical cookies (necessary for the website to function), analytical cookies (to measure traffic), and preference cookies (to remember your settings).

SUB_4.TITLE: 1.4 Consent
SUB_4.TEXT: By continuing to browse our website, you agree to the use of cookies described in this policy under the conditions stated herein.

SECTION_2.TITLE: 2. Cookie management and configuration
SECTION_2.INTRO_BOX: You have the right to manage, modify, or revoke your consent to the use of cookies at any time through your browser settings.

SUB_1.TITLE: 2.1 How to disable cookies
SUB_1.TEXT: You can restrict, block, or delete cookies from this website using your browser settings. The Help function of your browser will show you how to do this.

SUB_2.TITLE: 2.2 Links to major browsers
SUB_2.LIST_1: Google Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies.
SUB_2.LIST_2: Mozilla Firefox: Options > Privacy & Security > Cookies and site data.

SUB_3.TITLE: 2.3 Consequences of disabling cookies
SUB_3.TEXT: If you decide to disable cookies, some website features may not function properly, such as keeping you logged in or saving your preferences.

SUB_4.TITLE: 2.4 Third-party cookies
SUB_4.TEXT: Please note that if you accept third-party cookies, you must delete them from your browser options or from the system offered by the third party. The main services we use are:

SUB_5.TITLE: 2.5 Updates to this policy
SUB_5.TEXT: We may update our website's Cookie Policy, so we recommend you review this policy every time you visit us to stay properly informed.
